violation_type.title: Pest Extermination in Areas Where Children Present Treated Only if Allowed on Label (26 TAC §746.3429(b))
violation_type.short_title: Pest Extermination in Areas Where Children Present Treated Only if Allowed on Label
violation_type.typical_finding: Observed two rodent bait stations on the infant playground.

finding_variants.text: Observed two rodent bait stations on the infant playground.

Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance with The Minimum Standards for Child Care Centers. The label provided a keep out of reach of children warning.

This standard has been tasked as part of an investigation and is found to be deficient. The operation used a pesticide that was intended for outdoor use only in the classroom while a child was present.
It was determined in the course of the investigation that a rodent repellent was used around and in reach of the children, as the bottle stated to keep out of reach of children.

The operation failed to follow the directions on the label for a chemical cleaner and did not wipe down the surface before children entered the room, resulting in four toddlers needing medical attention.
